{{Quote|Corporal Amden vor Keioidian. You did the Republic proud. You did all of ''us'' proud. And we'll be back for you.|Sergeant Shanra Immel during the battle|<ref name="The Last Battle" />}}
During the [[Galactic War]] between the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]], a '''battle''' was fought on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kalandis Seven]]. The [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] gained momentum in the conflict after the news of a victory in the [[Battle of Corellia]], and a covert attack on a [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] and its subsequent bombing were severe blows to the Empire's efforts on the planet. The battle also saw [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] recalled back to the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] by [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]], where he would be appointed as [[Supreme Commander]] of the Republic Military at some point after the [[Battle of Ilum]].

==Prelude==
Around [[3642 BBY]], the [[Galactic War]] broke out between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]] after over a decade of peace during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. The Empire launched an offensive in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] as the war continued, invading the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] and sparking the lengthy [[Battle of Corellia]]. The Empire also attacked planets across the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] and the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], including [[Kalandis Seven]] in [[3640 BBY]].<ref name="The Last Battle" />

==The battle==
{{Quote|Sir. I'm in command of these men, and I'm not sending them&mdash;''"<br />"''You're not sending them anywhere. You finish the mission, and I go in alone. Won't draw attention that way.|Colonel Malcom decides to board the command ship while Immel completes the mission|<ref name="The Last Battle" />}}
The [[Imperial Navy (Sith Empire)|Imperial Navy]] deployed command ships around the planet, though the [[Republic Military/Legends|Republic Military]] was still able to gain a foothold on the surface as the [[Republic Navy/Legends|Republic Navy]] engaged the Imperial ships. Agents of the [[Republic Strategic Information Service]] aboard the ships began to propaganda down to the surface after the Battle of Corellia ended in a resounding victory for the Republic. The loss at Corellia forced the Empire to abandon its Coreward offensive, and [[Supreme Chancellor/Legends|Supreme Chancellor]] [[Leontyne Saresh]]'s victory speeches were used to inspire the fighters on Kalandis as they continued to fight amid Kalandis VII's fog-covered canyons and plains.<ref name="The Last Battle" />

[[File:Malcom_and_Immel.png|thumb|left|180px|Colonel Malcom and Sergeant Immel on Kalandis VII]]
During the battle, a [[Shanra Immel's squad|squad]] under the command of [[Sergeant/Legends|Sergeant]] [[Shanra Immel]] was tasked with destroying a nearby [[Spaceport/Legends|spaceport]] that was under Imperial control. [[Colonel/Legends|Colonel]] [[Jace Malcom]] of the [[Republic Special Forces Division]] was assigned in an advisory capacity to the unit, though the group was attacked on the way to their objective and [[Corporal/Legends|Corporal]] [[Amden vor Keioidian]] was critically injured. Immel decided to leave Keioidian behind with his [[med tracer]] active in hopes that he would be rescued, despite the possibility that the Empire might deploy the troopers known as "[[Vulture (trooper)|vultures]]" that hunted injured enemy combatants via their tracers, and the unit continued on to their objective. They reached their target three hours later, and the unit prepared to plant beacons on the spaceport so that the Republic's fighter wings could target the base accurately&mdash;a plan put together by Colonel Malcom.<ref name="The Last Battle" />

The attack was a success, as the Republic soldiers quickly eliminated the few sentries and personnel in their path in the south side of the spaceport and planted their beacons. However, Colonel Malcom spotted a planetary command ship that had just landed, and he decided to board the ship himself while Sergeant Immel's squad retreated and waited for the Republic fighters to arrive. Three hours later, Malcom began his attack aboard the ship, and he made his way to the bridge after eliminating the few sentries who made the mistake of crossing his path. Ignoring the scattered officers who were manning the ship's controls, Malcom charged the [[Unidentified Sith Overseer|Sith overseer]] who was in command of the vessel. The resulting brawl caught the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]] by surprise so that she could not use her [[Lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]], though she was still able to unleash a blast of [[Force lightning/Legends|lightning]] at the soldier before Malcom unloaded his [[Blaster rifle/Legends|blaster rifle]] into her stomach.<ref name="The Last Battle" />

[[File:Malcoms_on_a_Plane.png|thumb|right|170px|Colonel Malcom holds onto a Republic fighter]]
To Malcom's surprise, the officers fled the bridge after realizing that the Sith had activated the ship's [[Self-destruct mechanism/Legends|self-destruct mechanism]], and the soldier fell through the viewport of the cruiser as it tore itself apart. However, Malcom landed on the wing of a Republic fighter, saving him from falling to his [[Death/Legends|death]], and the colonel was taken to a nearby base where he boarded a shuttle to the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] ''[[Frontier Justice]]''. The ''Justice'' and its [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Kalandis Seven)|Jedi Knight]] pilot had been sent by the Supreme Chancellor herself, as Malcom was being recalled to the Core Worlds, though Malcom did not expect Sergeant Immel and her squad to survive longer than a month.<ref name="The Last Battle" />

==Aftermath==
{{Quote|Any idea why they sent you?''"<br />"''The Supreme Chancellor thinks you're wasted out here. Beyond that, I don't know. My guess is you're in for a promotion. Whole war is changing.|Jace Malcom and the Jedi Knight|<ref name="The Last Battle" />}}
Not long after the battle, Malcom was selected to replace [[Supreme Commander]] [[Rans]] by the Supreme Chancellor, and the Special Forces veteran continued to guide the Republic Military during the ongoing war with the Empire.<ref name="Annihilation" />

==Behind the scenes==
The battle of Kalandis Seven first appeared in ''[[The Last Battle of Colonel Jace Malcom]]'', a short story written by [[Alexander Freed]] for [[Star Wars Insider 137|''Star Wars Insider'' 137]] in [[2012]]. The story depicts Malcom's last assignment before being recalled to the Core Worlds,<ref name="The Last Battle" /> where he will be appointed as Supreme Commander at some point after the Battle of Ilum.<ref name="Annihilation" />
